spans.s:
mfn. (-घः-घा-घं)
1 Vain, useless, fruitless.
2 Left, abandoned.
f. (-घः)
Trumpet-flower, (Bignonia suave olens.)
m. (-घः)
A fence, a hedge.
E.
मुह to be foolish, aff. अच्, and the final changed.

mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म)
Following vain practices, observing useless-ceremonies.
E.
मोघ, and कर्म्मन् act.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Cultivating vain knowledge or any but religious wisdom.
E.
मोघ, and ज्ञान knowledge.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Indulging vain hopes.
E.
मोघ, and आशा hope.
